item_name: Insulin — Orders for insulin (number of days the physician changed the resident's insulin orders)

lookback_source.quote: Enter in Item N0350B, the number of days during the 7-day look-back period (or since admission/entry or reentry if less than 7 days) that the physician (nurse practitioner, physician assistant, or clinical nurse specialist if allowable under state licensure laws) changed the resident's insulin orders.

lookback_notes: 7-day look-back period, or since admission/entry or reentry if less than 7 days. The item's own pages state the 7-day window (p. N-3 Steps for Assessment and p. N-4 Coding Instructions). Per the general convention, a 7-day observation period consists of the ARD plus the 6 previous calendar days (rai-manual-v1.20.1, p. 2-21).

coding_levels.label: Number of days the physician (or authorized assistant or practitioner) changed the resident's insulin orders
coding_levels.definition: Record the number of days the physician (or authorized assistant or practitioner) changed the resident's insulin orders during the last 7 days or since admission/entry or reentry if less than 7 days.

source.quote: B. Orders for insulin Record the number of days the physician (or authorized assistant or practitioner) changed the resident's insulin orders during the last 7 days or since admission/entry or reentry if less than 7 days

federal_coding_rules.rule: Enter in Item N0350B the number of days during the 7-day look-back period (or since admission/entry or reentry if less than 7 days) that the physician (nurse practitioner, physician assistant, or clinical nurse specialist if allowable under state licensure laws) changed the resident's insulin orders.

source.quote: Enter in Item N0350B, the number of days during the 7-day look-back period (or since admission/entry or reentry if less than 7 days) that the physician (nurse practitioner, physician assistant, or clinical nurse specialist if allowable under state licensure laws) changed the resident's insulin orders.

federal_coding_rules.rule: A sliding scale dosage schedule written to cover different dosages depending on lab values does not count as an order change simply because a different dose is administered based on the sliding scale guidelines.

source.quote: A sliding scale dosage schedule that is written to cover different dosages depending on lab values does not count as an order change simply because a different dose is administered based on the sliding scale guidelines.

federal_coding_rules.rule: If the sliding scale order is new, discontinued, or is the first sliding scale order for the resident, these days can be counted and coded.

source.quote: If the sliding scale order is new, discontinued, or is the first sliding scale order for the resident, these days can be counted and coded.

federal_coding_rules.rule: For subcutaneous insulin pumps, code only the number of days that the resident actually required a subcutaneous injection to restart the pump.

source.quote: For subcutaneous insulin pumps, code only the number of days that the resident actually required a subcutaneous injection to restart the pump.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Determine, as part of assessment, whether the physician (or nurse practitioner, physician assistant, or clinical nurse specialist if allowable under state licensure laws) changed the resident's insulin orders during the look-back period, and count the number of days insulin orders were changed.

source.quote: Determine if the physician (or nurse practitioner, physician assistant, or clinical nurse specialist if allowable under state licensure laws) changed the resident's insulin orders during the look-back period.

federal.criterion: Review the resident's medication administration records for the 7-day look-back period (or since admission/entry or reentry if less than 7 days).

source.quote: Review the resident's medication administration records for the 7-day look-back period (or since admission/entry or reentry if less than 7 days).

federal.notes: Stated as step 1 of Steps for Assessment for N0350.

federal.criterion: Count the number of days insulin injections were received and/or insulin orders changed.

source.quote: Count the number of days insulin injections were received and/or insulin orders changed.

federal.notes: Step 4 of Steps for Assessment for N0350.

case_mix_relevance.notes: The supplied pages for N0350B do not tie this item to any payment or case-mix classification.
